title: Silent Push Joins Singapore's IMDA Spark Programme
content_md: Silent Push has been approved to join the IMDA Spark programme and will come aboard on November 1, 2026. Run by Singapore’s Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), Spark supports the growth of technology companies based in Singapore, using a mix of government support tools, community events, and access to industry mentors. Silent Push already supports security teams across Asia Pacific and Japan, so joining Spark puts that work inside Singapore’s own ecosystem, alongside the banks, agencies and service providers defending the region. What is the IMDA Spark programme? The IMDA Spark programme supports Singapore-based technology companies as they scale. IMDA describes its three objectives: lifting the capabilities of promising companies through a mix of government grant tools and support from industry community partners, giving enterprise tech companies the opportunity to pitch and build early reference customers in Singapore using government demand, and building a Singapore technology community that solves problems together.
